title: HyperHarness: Learning to Generate Personalized Agent Harnesses from User Histories
abstract: arXiv:2611.29062v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized LLM agents rely on an agent harness, the surrounding memory and control code, to connect user history with downstream decisions. Existing methods typically employ either a single shared memory workflow across all users, which is efficient to deploy but cannot adapt how evidence is retrieved and interpreted across diverse histories, or per-user harness optimization, which customizes behavior for each user but requires costly repeated candidate evaluation at deployment and suffers from sparse, noisy supervision in raw logs. To address this trade-off, we present HyperHarness, a framework that learns a shared history-to-harness generator to synthesize executable, user-specific retrieval and answer-guidance code directly from user histories. Given a user's permitted history, HyperHarness prompts a construction LLM to write personalized retrieval and guidance functions, while downstream task scores across training users supervise

translated_title: HyperHarness：从用户历史中学习生成个性化智能体框架
translated_abstract: 个性化LLM智能体依赖于一个智能体框架（即围绕模型的记忆与控制代码）来将用户历史与下游决策连接起来。现有方法通常采用两种方式之一：一种是在所有用户间共享单一的记忆工作流，虽然部署高效，但无法针对多样化的历史记录调整证据的检索与解读方式；另一种是对每个用户单独进行框架优化，虽能为每位用户定制行为，但在部署时需要代价高昂的反复候选评估，且原始日志中的监督信号稀疏且充满噪声。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了HyperHarness，该框架学习一个共享的“历史到框架”生成器，可直接从用户历史中合成可执行的、用户特定的检索与答案引导代码。给定用户的授权历史，HyperHarness会提示一个构建型LLM来编写个性化的检索与引导函数，同时利用训练用户的下游任务得分进行监督……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HyperHarness通过学习一个共享的“历史到框架”生成器，直接从用户历史合成可执行的个性化检索与答案引导代码，兼顾了共享工作流的部署效率与逐用户定制的行为适配能力。
en_tdlr: HyperHarness learns a shared history-to-harness generator that synthesizes executable, user-specific retrieval and answer-guidance code directly from user histories, balancing the deployment efficiency of shared workflows with per-user behavioral adaptation.
